mentions.name: EEG-driven GAN art project
mentions.description: An art project that reads brain activity with a Muse EEG headset and uses it to drive the output of a GAN, visualizing or decoding thoughts as generated imagery; currently limited by compute and hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: Using a Muse EEG headset to read brain activity and use that to drive the output of a GAN. Similar to other projects that try to visualise or decode thoughts, but at the moment it's an art project.
